interpretation.fidelity_check: the full_eval block reproduces the published pair_known micro accuracies and macro recalls exactly, which is what licenses reading the clean_subset block as the same pipeline on other rows
interpretation.caveats: single seed, so the McNemar p-values test rows within one trained pair and say nothing about seed variance; B2 and B4 differ in parameter count, so a B2-vs-B4 difference is not separable from a capacity effect
